text.en:
Section 8 of Presidential Decree No. 538 is hereby amended to read as follows:
"Sec. 8. Tax Treatment of Merchandise in the Areas. Any provision of law to the contrary notwithstanding,
raw materials, supplies, articles, equipment, machineries, spare parts and wares of every description, except
those prohibited by law, brought in the Areas and utilized in the production, storing, packing and shipment of
goods meant for foreign markets shall be exempt from customs duties, internal revenue taxes, local tax
ordinances, and wharfage dues on those brought after January 1, 1977 through piers or wharves constructed
by the importer with his or its private funds."

This Decree shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 11th day of June, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-eight.
